# runzero_custom_integration (Data Source)

Fetches a single RunZero custom integration by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the custom integration.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The client UUID.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the custom integration was created.
- `created_by_id` (String) The UUID of the user who created the custom integration.
- `description` (String) The description of the custom integration.
- `destroyed_at` (String) Timestamp when the custom integration was destroyed.
- `icon` (String) The icon of the custom integration.
- `name` (String) The name of the custom integration.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the custom integration was last updated.
